remarks: Sun pours into this beautifully renovated 2 BR, 1.5 BA Condo, spacious unit in the heart of downtown Greenwich! Renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances (refrigerator 2 years old) and renovated baths. Large Living/Dining Area with Hardwood floors throughout unit. Primary Bedroom with 2 walk-in closets, 2nd Bedroom with spacious closet. Condo complex offers free laundry room plus party/social room. Plenty of private off-street parking on property. Sliding Patio doors to private garden area. 8'x4' private secure storage space. New HVAC & hot water heater installed in March 2026. Blocks to Greenwich Ave Shops, Resturants and Train Station, easy access to I95. This is a perfect location for commuter living.
